title: Slack KB Record
description: Structured log record for Slack KB (v1)

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of when the record was logged

entity_id.description: Identifier of the affected entity (from QR code, deep link, or POC default)

context.description: Descriptive context for the entity (e.g. Team / System / Service)

severity.description: Severity level inferred by Claude from the raw message

category.description: Issue category inferred by Claude from the raw message (e.g. Outage, Performance, Security)

description.description: Clear, concise description of the issue generated by Claude

tags.description: Relevant lowercase tags extracted by Claude

reported_by.description: Slack user ID of the team member who posted the #log message

thread_ts.description: Slack thread timestamp — used to anchor conversational follow-up

channel.description: Slack channel ID where the record was reported

note_url.description: S3 URI of the full markdown record note

raw_message.description: Original unmodified Slack message text from the team member
